paragraphs.source_en: "Look, it's a bad situation," he said after they had talked for an hour. "But if you strike for long, you'll only make it worse. They'll send in security and it won't be like living with gangs and police among you, it'll be like livng in prison. You've made your point already, and now you've got to know when to let off and negotiate. Form a committee to represent you, and make a list of complaints and demands. Document all the incidents of crime, just write them down and get the victims to sign the statements. I'll make good use of them. It's going to take work at UNOMA and back home, because they're breaking the treaty."
